article.body: From Tapping to Hopping is a research method for augmenting mobile GUI agents with app-native deeplinks. The work is available as an arXiv paper; no deployed product, user tier, platform release, API, or access restrictions are specified. Its stated change is to let mobile GUI agents use app-native deeplinks in addition to tapping through graphical interfaces, but the supplied record does not establish the exact workflow or prior baseline. This is a research proposal, not a shipped capability, and the available evidence provides no independently verified results, technical limitations, or comparison with existing mobile-agent systems.
